question: Breadth for the encoder claim: with the LIIF decoder and the identical 200-epoch recipe of v5, does a Transformer encoder (SwinIR, official LTE repo models/swinir.py) also raise R(u) only above the LR Nyquist relative to EDSR-baseline?
comparison: liif-edsr-200ep from claude-20261019-encoder-train-v5 (same recipe, seed 1). Eval with run_v3.py on DIV2K 0869-0900.

predictions_frozen_before_training.S1: SwinIR-LIIF R(u) > EDSR-LIIF R(u) in >=80% of u-bins in [1,2) at x2,3,4.
predictions_frozen_before_training.S2: |difference| <= 0.01 in >=80% of u-bins in [0,0.75) at x2,3,4.
predictions_frozen_before_training.S3: SwinIR-LIIF m=2 cell cost decreases strictly x2>x3>x4>x6.

caveat: SwinIR trained with LIIF batch16/inp48 recipe, not its original recipe; single seed; short schedule. User approved running the official LTE SwinIR code on 2026-10-19.
